## The claim

Fewer than 20% of protein-coding genes have no HPO curation at all.

**Prediction if true.** The count of protein-coding genes absent from the HPO annotation corpus is < 20% of the protein-coding total.

**What would refute it.** >= 20% are uncurated — the target set's coverage claim is weakened and the uncurated tier is reported as the larger blind spot it then is.

## Evidence

| # | Direction | Strength | Kind | Observation | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 37 | refutes | 0.95 | measurement | 14,523 of 19,723 protein-coding genes in the Ensembl-derived coding regions have no HPO curation at all (73.6%), against the predicted under 20%. | `docs/iteration2/step-1/methodology/084-the-blind-target-set.md` |
